messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate (gateway/timeout) detected for tenant=orionlogistics on dedicated cluster rg-prod-gpu-07. Error rate: 17% over 5m, baseline 0.6%. Auto-escalation: paging on-call.

sara: ack — I'm oncall. paging jamal for lead. will start triage.

jamal: on it. initial ask: is this noisy neighbor (one tenant consuming all streams) or infra (OOM/eviction)? can someone paste recent qps per-tenant?

mike: past 10m qps snapshot from metrics: 
```
tenant.orionlogistics.qps: 420 -> 980
tenant.alpha-beta.qps: 12
tenant-gamma.qps: 5
```
Looks like orion spiked. also seeing high KV cache churn in that pool.

anita: logs from gateway show a lot of 502/504 like this: 
```
2027-06-04T14:07:23Z gateway proxy -> 10.3.1.44:504 502 downstream: upstream reset
2027-06-04T14:07:25Z router -> runtime: timeout waiting for response (deadline exceeded)
```

lucy: cluster autoscaler hasn't triggered because pool is at max capacity: pool-size=16, target-util=92%. No immediate headroom.

jamal: ok. likely capacity exhaustion + one tenant causing long tail. mitigation plan: 1) scale pool (if possible) 2) apply tenant throttling for orion 3) evict long-running sessions for that tenant 4) route new orion requests to fallback model variant in next region. I'll coordinate.

sara: +1. I'll open a support ticket to Orion to notify of degraded experience and ask for any batch job they may be running. @prod-support-orion will you call their SRE?

prod-support-orion: on it, trying phone and slack with their infra team. they confirm a release at 14:00 that's running heavy batch reranks. they didn't expect it to route to dedicated cluster though — they thought it was on-hosted. investigating.

mike: starting scale-now attempt: `rdwctl cluster scale rg-prod-gpu-07 --replicas 20`

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: scale requested by mike at 1800034690.

lucy: autoscaler rejected manual scale due to quota constraints in region. provisioning delay estimate 4-6m.

jamal: since scale will be slow, evict longest-running sessions for orion from pool: `rdwctl evict-sessions --tenant orionlogistics --pool rg-prod-gpu-07 --age >30m` — please confirm. This will drop active in-flight requests (may cause client retries).

anita: recommended: set soft throttle to 20 rps for orion at gateway first, then evict. I'll push throttle rule.

mike: pushed throttle rule to edge: `route-filter: tenant==orionlogistics -> max_rps=20`  at 14:11:40

jamal: now evicting long sessions. `rdwctl evict` returned 8 sessions evicted, 4 sessions stuck (retrying).

incident-bot: NOTE: Fallback routing enabled for orion to fallback-model small-v2 in eu-west-1 at 14:12:55. Traffic split 30/70 (fallback/primary)

sara: customer impact update: 35% of orion's requests are now getting fallback model (higher latency but lower error). Overall 5xx dropped to 6% within 2m. Sending a status update to Orion SRE now.

prod-support-orion: Orion SRE confirmed they paused their batch at 14:14 and are rolling back the job. They also asked for our suggested rate limit.

anita: continue monitoring. I see gateway 5xx trending down, but there's a persistent 504 tail on a specific host 10.3.1.44. logging indicates KV cache eviction thrashing on that host.

mike: isolating host 10.3.1.44 from pool (cordon) to see if it stabilizes: `rdwctl node cordon 10.3.1.44 --pool rg-prod-gpu-07`

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: node cordoned by mike at 1800034768.

lucy: cordon succeeded, traffic rebalanced across remaining nodes. CPU on others spiked but acceptable. 5xx now ~1.2% over 5m. latency 95p improved.

jamal: good. remediation summary: throttled tenant -> evicted stale sessions -> enabled fallback routing -> cordoned noisy host -> initiated scale (pending).

sara: I'm handing off to jamal for continued watch. I'll update incident channel and create a dedicated postmortem ticket. jamal, please include mitigations and customer comms.

jamal: taking watch. I'll keep rw oncall looped and start a post-incident timeline. next steps: 1) follow up on quota to allow faster scaling 2) recommend per-tenant soft caps for heavy customers and alerting on sustained qps spikes 3) postmortem with Orion and infra.

prod-support-orion: Customer impact: degraded throughput and higher latency for ~13 minutes, some requests retried by their client. They accepted the mitigation and will schedule a production change window to move the batch off-dedicated. Thanks team.

sara: closing pager for now but keeping the thread open for postmortem. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-sre for root-cause follow-up. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to P2 at 1800034820. follow-up tasks created: PM-2891 (postmortem), INF-742 (quota review), OPS-1102 (tenant throttling default).
